part_functions.name: Levered motion transmission
part_functions.function: The long flat arm provides mechanical leverage and transmits force or torque to the socket hub near one end.

part_functions.name: Blind cylindrical interface
part_functions.function: The hub provides a front-accessed blind cylindrical socket for locating on, coupling to, or rotating about a mating cylindrical member.

part_functions.name: Arm-to-hub structural relationship
part_functions.function: The hub is integral with the arm and is supported by a broad blended transition that distributes load between the cylindrical hub and the thin plate.

part_functions.name: Coaxial hub relationship
part_functions.function: The outer hub cylinder, annular opening, inner cylindrical wall, and blind cavity floor share a common axis parallel to the Y direction.

sections.name: Long plate arm with rounded tail

section_functions.name: Arm geometry and location
section_functions.function: A thin plate extending primarily along X from the rounded tail at x=-25 mm to the square end at x=80 mm, spanning y=11 to 23 mm and z=2 to 6 mm.

section_functions.name: Load-carrying lever
section_functions.function: Acts as the primary bending and torque-transmitting member; its 4 mm thickness resists out-of-plane loading while its long span supplies leverage.

feature_functions.name: Force transmission
feature_functions.function: Carries operating force between the free square end and the hub region; the opposed planar faces form a constant-thickness structural beam.

feature_functions.name: Structural adjacency
feature_functions.function: The beam is contiguous with the rounded tail at its negative-X end and with the hub transition around x=0 on its y=23 side.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Long rear side wall of the arm at y=11 mm.
Broad bottom face of the arm at z=2 mm, locally bounded by the tail and hub junction.
Square free-end face of the lever at x=80 mm.
Long front side wall at y=23 mm extending from the hub region to the square end.
Broad top face of the arm at z=6 mm, locally bounded by the tail and hub junction.
Short front-side segment at y=23 mm between the rounded tail and the hub transition.

feature_functions.name: End shaping
feature_functions.function: Closes the negative-X end with a large cylindrical arc, eliminating sharp plan-view corners and providing a smooth terminal profile.

feature_functions.name: Structural continuity
feature_functions.function: Joins the arm's rear side, front-side segment, top face, and bottom face as an integral constant-thickness end.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Radius-17.5 mm curved perimeter face forming the rounded negative-X end of the plate.

section_functions.name: Transition geometry and location
section_functions.function: A bulbous blended region centered near x=0 and y=19 to 24 mm, wrapping around the hub root and merging it into the front edge and broad faces of the arm.

section_functions.name: Stress distribution
section_functions.function: Increases the local load-transfer area and reduces the geometric discontinuity between the thin plate and the larger cylindrical hub.

feature_functions.name: Hub support
feature_functions.function: Supports the socket hub against bending and torsional loads by spreading those loads into the arm over a broad curved surface.

feature_functions.name: Structural relationship
feature_functions.function: The blend is directly adjacent to the arm faces and the radius-7 mm outer hub cylinder, forming their integral connection.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Compound curved transition surface around the hub root, spanning x=-7 to 7 mm, y=19 to 24 mm, and z=-3 to 11 mm.

section_functions.name: Hub geometry and location
section_functions.function: A hollow cylindrical boss centered at x=0 and z=4 mm, projecting in the positive-Y direction to y=34 mm with a 7 mm outer radius and a 5 mm blind internal radius.

section_functions.name: Mating and retention interface
section_functions.function: Receives a cylindrical mating element through the front annular opening; the bore wall locates it radially and the blind floor limits axial insertion.

features.name: Outer cylindrical hub shell and rim

feature_functions.name: Socket housing
feature_functions.function: Provides the material surrounding the blind bore and transfers interface loads into the blended root.

feature_functions.name: Opening support
feature_functions.function: The annular front rim surrounds and reinforces the open end of the socket.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Radius-7 mm outer cylindrical wall of the hub, coaxial with the internal socket and adjacent to the root blend.
Front annular end face at y=34 mm surrounding the radius-5 mm socket opening.

feature_functions.name: Radial location
feature_functions.function: The radius-5 mm cylindrical wall guides and radially locates a nominal 10 mm diameter mating pin, shaft, or tool.

feature_functions.name: Axial stop
feature_functions.function: The planar cavity floor at y=25 mm closes the bore and establishes its approximately 9 mm insertion depth.

feature_functions.name: Coaxial relationship
feature_functions.function: The bore is coaxial with the outer hub shell along the Y axis and opens through the annular front rim.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Radius-5 mm internal cylindrical socket wall extending from the front opening toward the blind floor.
Circular blind-bore floor at y=25 mm providing the axial insertion stop.
